# Basit Amin Bhatti

> Official personal website and canonical identity of Basit Amin Bhatti, also known as Basit Bhatti and Basit Amin.

Basit Amin Bhatti is the Pakistan-based founder of BAVEXA and an AI Growth Partner for Roofing Companies. He helps U.S. roofing companies respond to leads faster, qualify opportunities, automate follow-up, update their CRM, and turn more inquiries into booked roof inspections. BAVEXA is his flagship AI lead-conversion system for roofing companies.
